title: Hunts FH-032S: Plug live partner state and the finale broadcast into route health

source.ref: Split from FH-032 (2026-11-16): route health shipped over the tables on main; FH-029 and FH-031 were being built in parallel and are not read yet.

detail:
Route health (lib/hunts/route-health.ts) decides which Spaces are venues in one function, activeVenues, from the hunt_partners rows with the authz liveness rule, and reports the Hunt outbox as its message status. Owed by an agent once FH-029 and FH-031 are on main: read the live partner state from lib/hunts/partners.ts in activeVenues (pinned terms, the named steward, a withdrawn venue keeps its historic counts and drops from the active list), and add the finale broadcast state from lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts beside the outbox counts on /hunts/<slug>/health. Also link the two pages (/hunts/<slug>/health for organisers, /hunts/<slug>/report for venue staff) from the Trail's manage screen. Done when: a venue withdrawn through the partner flow leaves the organiser's active venue list on the next read while its past counts still reconcile, and the organiser sees whether the finale broadcast went out. Requires: FH-029, FH-031, FH-032. Owner role: Operations and analytics.

Built 2026-11-16. activeVenues now asks partnerLive (lib/hunts/partners.ts), the rule publish and the claim path use, so a venue that withdrew or was suspended leaves the organiser's active list on the next read. Its confirmed stops, players and rewards handed over move unchanged to a Past venues table (formerVenues), and lib/hunts/route-health.test.ts proves the active and former counts add up to what they were before the withdrawal. Each partner venue shows the steward its invite named (a name, never an id) and whether the terms it pinned are the current ones; where migration 20270346081000 is not applied those two columns read as not on record and the page still loads. The finale: lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts names the outbox event a finale notice is sent as (finale.broadcast) and finaleBroadcastState reads its counts; /hunts/<slug>/health shows it beside the outbox counts as No finale, Not sent, Sending, Sent or Failed. The Trail's edit screen links route health (organisers) and the venue report (venue staff) once the Trail has been published and HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED is on. No migration, no new switch. Not built: nothing sends a finale notice yet, so a Trail with a finale reads Not sent, which is true. Sending it is FH-032T.
